choices: Copies a method to a new file
Moves selected code into a new named method, replacing the original code with a call to it
Generates a method signature from its call site
explanation: Extract Method (IntelliJ: Ctrl+Alt+M) identifies the selected code block, creates a new private method with appropriate parameters and return type, and replaces the original code with a call to the new method. It reduces duplication and improves readability.
